blocks.text: Anti-Drip with SmartSteam & Auto Shut Off Compact yet powerful, this easy-to-use nonstick iron features proprietary SmartSteam technology, automatically regulating steam level based on fabric setting to streamline controls and take the guesswork out of ironing. The 3-way auto shutoff provides added peace of mind.

items.label: ANTI-DRIP SMARTSTREAM TECHNOLOGY
items.value: Engineered to prevent dripping by maintaining water at the proper temperature needed to generate steam. Volts : 120V. Wattage : 1200W. Requires AC Power. Easy-Fill Translucent Water Tank.

items.label: 3-WAY AUTO SHUTOFF
items.value: Get peace of mind with motion-sensitive technology that automatically shuts off the iron if left inactive on its heel, side or soleplate. To clean iron, wipe soleplate and outer surfaces with a soft cloth dampened with water.

items.label: TRUEGLIDE NONSTICK SOLEPLATE
items.value: The enhanced soleplate is designed to glide smoothly across all fabric types for ease of use. Recommended for fabrics such as Cotton/Wool/Blend/Polyester/Rayon/Nylon/Synthetic.

items.label: SPRAY MIST
items.value: This push-button mister helps moisten fabrics to tackle and smooth away deep wrinkles.

items.label: ERGONOMIC COMFORT GRIP HANDLE
items.value: comfort grip handle ergonomically shaped to fit hand contours for comfort, while 360° pivoting cord allows for easy maneuverability.

items.label: Special Features
items.value: Anti-Drip, Auto Shutoff, Lightweight, Non-Stick Soleplate, Spray & Steam Burst Setting
